intent: The editor's grown compose branch catches up with the design DT-0001/0002 gave the rest of the page: the sections checklist gets its treatment, the refusal branches take their roles, and the blast radius wears the same clothes on compose that it already wears on review.
rationale: The surface went needs-redesign because behavior grew under a designed page — the compose form gained a sections checklist, a limits sentence, and a strategy-unreadable branch, none of which existed when DT-0001/0002 were written. The review panel itself is untouched: DT-0002's treatments survived the growth and this ticket does not reopen them. What is decided here: (1) the checklist's native checkboxes take accent-color color.accent.default and their label rows take the size.control.min floor on touch viewports — a checkbox row is a tap target, and the 44px principle does not exempt small controls; desktop keeps its current density. (2) compile-rejected is a bounced attempt and its reason takes danger (DT-0004's class); 'Nothing was changed.' is the absence-of-effect sentence and takes quiet, per the system principle that absence gets the same visual commitment as a warning. (3) vocabulary-unavailable is a refusal to proceed, not a failed attempt — DT-0004's refusal-to-mint precedent — and takes notice, role=alert kept. (4) The compose branch's bound-agent sentence is the blast radius met a page earlier, and the same fact wears the same clothes: consequence treatment when agents are reached, plain when none are. (5) Single-exit terminal branches (strategy-not-found, strategy-unreadable, vocabulary-unavailable) make their one way out a BUTTON_SECONDARY target per DT-0006; compile-rejected's two-link row stays text links in its deliberate order, matching the trim page's nothing-to-trim precedent. Not decided here, deliberately: strategy-unreadable shows no reason because the read result carries none up — surfacing one is behavior (see backlog strategy-unreadable-arrives-without-a-reason); and the ungrouped templates block stays unlabelled because naming a group the platform returned without a name would invent vocabulary.

design.layout: Unchanged — one full-page branch at a time; compose keeps heading, blast radius, tagline, sections fieldset, compile, back link.

not-connected.content: Unchanged — the shared component, DT-0006's treatment.

strategy-not-found.content: Heading unchanged. The single 'Back to your strategies' exit becomes an anchor wearing BUTTON_SECONDARY — the way out as a target at the 44px floor, DT-0006's ruling for one-remedy pages.

strategy-unreadable.content: Same shell as strategy-not-found — heading unchanged, the single exit wears BUTTON_SECONDARY. The wording keeps the two branches distinguishable (spec strategy-authoring spec.md:329-332); no reason block is added because no reason reaches this page today — that is behavior, tracked as backlog strategy-unreadable-arrives-without-a-reason, not restyled around.

vocabulary-unavailable.content: The explanation paragraph takes notice: color.notice.subtle background, 1px color.notice.border border, radius.2, space.4 padding, color.text.primary; role=alert stays. A refusal to proceed, not a failed attempt — nothing is styled as retryable. The 'Back to strategy' exit wears BUTTON_SECONDARY.

compose.content: The bound-agent sentence above the fields wears what the review's blast radius wears: when agents would be reconfigured, a consequence block — color.consequence.subtle background, 1px color.consequence.border border, radius.2, space.4 padding, the count kept in the sentence; when no agents are bound, the plain sentence unchanged. Same fact, same clothes, one page earlier. Everything else on the compose shell is unchanged.

compile-rejected.content: BattleGrid's reason takes danger: color.danger.subtle background, 1px color.danger.default border, radius.2, space.4 padding, role=alert kept, the platform's wording verbatim. 'Nothing was changed.' takes quiet: color.quiet.subtle background, 1px color.quiet.border border, radius.2, space.4 padding — the absence of effect visually committed, never sharing danger's palette. The two links keep their order and text-link treatment (another attempt first, the way back second — the trim page's precedent for two-choice rows).

review-applicable.content: Unchanged — DT-0002's review, the shared button constants, the back link.

review-apply-refused.content: Unchanged — the full review still renders with the refusal per DT-0002; this ticket does not touch the panel.

default.content: tagline: unchanged — CONTROL and LABEL constants. sections: the checklist's native checkboxes take accent-color color.accent.default; each label row keeps its gap and text size.

focused.content: tagline: unchanged — focus ring comes from the one global rule in globals.css; no per-element ring.

grouped-by-category.content: Unchanged — sub-fieldsets with their small uppercase secondary legends, at the platform's grouping; the set and count of groups is discovered, never assumed.

ungrouped-templates.content: Unchanged and deliberately unlabelled — the platform returned these without a category, and a heading this product invented would be read as the platform's.

current-sections-preselected.content: Unchanged — pre-checked state comes from the strategy and renders through the same checkbox treatment; checked state is signalled by the control itself plus its accent, never by row colour alone.

published.content: limits: unchanged — the sentence stays color.text.secondary at its small size inside the fieldset, ending with refuses-rather-than-truncates.

absent.content: limits: renders nothing, unchanged — no invented ceiling (spec strategy-authoring spec.md:372-374); an empty state that must stay empty.

responsive.mobile: Each checkbox label row takes min-height size.control.min so every row is a 44px tap target; blocks full width in the existing centered column.
responsive.desktop: Checkbox rows return to their current density (no min-height); nothing else moves.

acceptance: Section checkboxes render with accent-color color.accent.default
On a mobile viewport every checkbox label row is at least size.control.min tall; on desktop the current density is unchanged
The compile-rejected reason renders on color.danger.subtle with a 1px color.danger.default border, role=alert kept, wording verbatim
'Nothing was changed.' renders on color.quiet.subtle with a 1px color.quiet.border border and never shares danger's palette
The vocabulary-unavailable explanation renders on color.notice.subtle with a 1px color.notice.border border, role=alert kept
On strategy-not-found, strategy-unreadable, and vocabulary-unavailable the single exit link is an anchor wearing BUTTON_SECONDARY

On compose with one or more bound agents, the reconfigured-count sentence renders on color.consequence.subtle with a 1px color.consequence.border border; with zero bound agents it stays a plain sentence
The compile submit still wears BUTTON_SECONDARY and no second accent button appears on the compose branch
The review branches render exactly as before this ticket — no visual change to plan-review-panel, blast-radius, or changed-axes
Zero copy changes anywhere on the page
No raw color, spacing, or size literal is introduced

references.value: Backlog 157 (the design lane's tail) — the refresh that found this surface needs-redesign. Restates DT-0004 (danger for bounced attempts, notice for refusals), DT-0006 (the remedy as a target), DT-0011 (role hierarchy), and the system principle on absence for quiet. The strategy-unreadable reason gap is behavior: backlog strategy-unreadable-arrives-without-a-reason.
